description: A stacked bar chart whose tooltip omits the category heading and shows only the series rows.
overview: A stacked bar chart whose tooltip drops the category heading and shows only the series rows. Use it when the hovered category is obvious from the axis and you want a smaller tooltip.
usage: Set `hideLabel` on `ChartTooltipContent`. Replace `chartData` and the series in `chartConfig` with your own.
notes: The tooltip opens on a preset month when the chart loads; remove `defaultIndex` if it should start hidden.
